title: Reward Your Play: Complete Quests. Earn Orbs. Get Sweet Stuff.
summary: Introducing a new type of Quest reward: Discord Orbs! Earn them by completing Quests and redeem them in the Shop for hundreds of different items — including Discord Nitro credit. Available on desktop and mobile.
body:
Fellow Quest-goers, listen in: lately, there’s a good chance you’ve seen certain Quests offering something called “Discord Orbs” for completing them. You may be pondering: what the heck IS an Orb?

Discord Orbs are a type of Quest reward available on both desktop and mobile! Tackle Quests, grow a spherical stash of Orbs, and redeem them in the Shop for tons of stuff, like Orb-themed profile items or the most fabled thing on all of Discord: Nitro itself… 3-Day Nitro credits to be precise! You can also spend Discord Orbs on many of your favorite items in the Shop.

…what’s that rolling sound? Oh, would you look at that! It’s the sound of the Orbs you’ll earn over at the Quests page! Use the button below to see if there are any Quests available to you that offer up Orbs as a reward:

Earn Some Discord Orbs
